connectedToApp.message: The browser extension is connected to the app
connectedToApp.description: Indicates that the extension is connected to the main installed OneKeePass app

redetectLoginFields.description: Button on the connected popup that re-scans the current page for login fields

noDbAvailable.message: Please open a browser connection enabled database and then try

noMatchingEntry.message: No matching entry was found for this login URL in any open database
noMatchingEntry.description: No matching entry is found for the url

addUrlToEntry.message: Please add this URL to the URL or Additional URLs field of a relevant login entry
addUrlToEntry.description: Tells the user how to make this login URL match an entry

fieldsNotFilled.message: Some fields were not filled because they are hidden or covered
fieldsNotFilled.description: Shown when a login field is skipped during autofill for safety

embeddedLoginFrom.description: Label above the cross-origin frame origin a credential will be filled into; shown only when the login fields are in an embedded (cross-origin) iframe

appIsNotRunning.message: There is no connection to the locally installed app. The app may not be running. Please start the app and then reconnect
appIsNotRunning.description: The main app should be running for the browser extension to work
